name: Jaddai
overview: Jaddai is a male figure mentioned in the book of Ezra as a descendant of Nebo who had married a foreign wife. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture provides limited information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal details.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Jaddai' appears as a proper name in Ezra 10:43 without any given Hebrew or Greek meaning. Therefore, the name is noted plainly without further etymological significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Jaddai is a descendant of Nebo, establishing a direct familial link. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jaddai's mention in Ezra 10:43 highlights the issue of intermarriage with foreign wives during the post-exilic period, a matter addressed by the returning Israelites seeking to maintain covenant faithfulness. His identification as a descendant of Nebo who had married a foreign wife situates him within this broader narrative of restoration and obedience to God's commands.
